description: This file defines the 'iron-selection' component, specifically the 'Polymer.IronSelection' class, which manages item selection logic including selecting, toggling, clearing, and querying selected items. It uses Polymer's infrastructure and provides selection management for custom elements.

classes.name: Polymer.IronSelection
classes.description: A class managing item selection, supporting single and multiple selection modes. It maintains a selection array, supports selecting, toggling, clearing, and querying selection state, and invokes a callback upon selection changes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the selected item(s). If 'multi' is true, returns a copy of the selection array; otherwise returns the first selected item or undefined.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all selected items except those specified in the 'excludes' array.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a given item is currently selected.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state of a specific item, adding or removing it from the selection array and invoking the callback.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects a specific item. If multi-selection mode is active, toggles selection; otherwise, selects only the specified item.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the selection state of a given item.
